steps.note: Open the single-stage event setup screen.
Choose RFQ and select whole-lot awarding.

args.label: How will you award the event?
options: I'll award the entire lot to single Vendor
I may partially award the event to multiple

steps.note: Verify the RFQ exposes the expected awarding configuration choices.
Add a product to form the lot.
Invite a vendor to the RFQ.
Confirm the RFQ reached a published project page.
Have the invited vendor submit an RFQ bid.
Confirm the vendor bid was accepted.
Close the bidding window so the event can be awarded.
Award the lot to the lowest bidder using the whole-lot configuration.
Confirm the award proposal was created and submitted.
Open the comparison and award context for the published RFQ.
Verify the complete lot is allocated to exactly one vendor.
